notes.title: Demo Update and Kickstarter Campaign Preview!
notes.content:
We are happily announcing preview of our Kickstarter Campaign! The campaign will start at November 11 and will run for 30 days, with a humble goal of €3000. Follow our campaign here: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/phns/court-of-crowns-a-historical-drama-visual-novel]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/phns/court-of-crowns-a-historical-drama-visual-novel[/url]

We are also updating our demo to version 1.8.1. Based on feedback and observations of playing it content creators, we have made following improvements:

•	Demonstrate button’s placement has been changed, for better visibility.
•	Clarification for second phase of Clash of Arguments’ tutorial.
•	We have added an indicator, when you are supposed to click an area on the map.

We also have added a link to our Kickstarter Campaign.

notes.title: Demo 1.8 release
notes.content:
Based on feedback, we have added following improvements to our demo:

[list]
[*] You can now reduce or turn off comedic sound effects
[*] Screen shake effect has been improved
[*] You can turn off screen shake
[*] Tutorial for Interrogation gameplay section has been added
[*] You can turn off tutorials (in Interrogation and Clash of Arguments)
[/list]
